text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Supervising master confirmed. Greetings, Master. I am Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The goal: to become Triple Crown champion. This is both my own ambition and my father's dream.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Preparations for achieving the goal are complete. Please commence training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
